gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma; Recurrent Glioblastoma; Supratentorial Glioblastoma; Brain Tumor
Recurrent supratentorial glioblastoma (GBM) confirmed via prior histology by the site's neuropathologist or designate.

candidate_evidence.quote: Pembrolizumab (200 mg IV) given every 3 weeks.
Lerapolturev delivered once intratumorally via convection enhanced delivery. Pembrolizumab given intravenously every 3 weeks.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: LUMINOS-101: Lerapolturev (PVSRIPO) and Pembrolizumab in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: Lerapolturev (5x10\^7 TCID50) delivered intratumorally via convection enhanced delivery (CED).

coder_notes: Lerapolturev is an oncolytic poliovirus, so excluded intervention type; pembrolizumab is the only pharmacological candidate (as in the manual's pembrolizumab plus vaccine example). MGMT appears only in prior-therapy description, not as an entry requirement.
